loss.weighting_note: Recomputed from this source's known training labels only: multiclass sqrt inverse frequency normalized to mean 1; multilabel sqrt(negative/positive) capped at 10. No validation/test labels used for weighting.

notes: UNTRAINED CONFIGURATION: no formal training or cloud GPU memory/throughput benchmark has been performed. DINOv2 ViT-B/14 at 392; epochs1-5 train only the classification head, epochs6-30 train the last4 transformer blocks plus norm and head; no full-backbone unfreezing during this 30-epoch schedule. Use only the declared single source; preserve audited label order, source-specific training loss weights and all fixed split manifests. Never concatenate sources or tasks automatically. Use legacy stretch preprocessing and native-resolution augmentation, without an image cache by default. DR crop/letterbox is a separate experiment and is not applied here. RFMiD retains rotation_degrees=10 and color_jitter=0.1; use masked known labels for the five independent sigmoid outputs. Batch size, accumulation, staged tuning and preprocessing for this architecture require a cloud preflight and a limited explicit profile before formal training. Creating or validating this config does not start training.
